## The week at a glance

| Day | Lesson | Superpower gained |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [The 7 Patterns of R](day1-patterns.qmd) | see structure in R's chaos |
| 2 | [Data Structures](day2-data-structures.qmd) | `[`/`[[`/`$` ↔ `[]`/`.loc`/`.iloc` fluency |
| 3 | [Control Flow + Functions](day3-functions.qmd) | functions with guards, `case_when`, closures |
| 4 | [Algorithm Gym #1](day4-gym1.qmd) | big-O thinking + the hash-map pattern |
| 5 | [Strings, Dates + Project 1](day5-strings-project1.qmd) | clean a real messy dataset, twice |

## Ground rules for the week

1. **Write tidyverse-first**, read base R fluently
2. Every function gets **guard clauses** (`stopifnot`) — from today on
3. No `1:length(x)` — ever
4. Do every exercise **twice** when it's cheap: once per dialect
5. End-of-week checkpoint: Project 1 produces identical numbers in R and Python

## Drill rule

Predict the output **out loud** before running any cell. Being wrong on
purpose is the fastest refresher there is.
